description:
Overview

The GT33 is a high-power all-terrain cargo electric bike designed for riders who want to carry more, ride further, and handle everyday tasks with ease. Powered by a 1350W peak motor reaching up to 34 MPH, with a long-range 48V 27Ah battery and reinforced frame, the GT33 is built for both urban commuting and real-world cargo use, from grocery runs to outdoor adventures.

Key Features

Performance

1350W peak motor for strong acceleration and hill climbing

Top speed up to 34 MPH (55 km/h)

258 Nm of torque for carrying cargo on any terrain

Designed for both city riding and outdoor use

Cargo & Utility

Reinforced frame designed for carrying heavy loads

Extended seat and cargo space for gear, bags, or passengers

Balanced structure for stable riding even when loaded

Range & Power System

48V 27Ah battery for extended riding range

Dual-battery ready design for longer trips

Removable battery for convenient charging

Comfort & Control

Full suspension system for smoother rides on rough roads

Fat tires for improved comfort, grip, and stability

Upright riding position for better visibility and control

Safety & Stability

Hydraulic disc brakes for reliable stopping power

Stable frame geometry for carrying cargo safely

Designed for confident riding under load

Design & Experience

Cafe racer / moped-inspired design with cargo capability

Comfortable for long rides and everyday use

Suitable for commuting, errands, and outdoor trips

Who is this bike for?

The GT33 cargo electric bike is ideal for:

Riders looking for a cargo eBike for daily use

Users who need to carry groceries, gear, or equipment

Commuters who want a powerful and versatile electric bike

Riders who want a stable bike for heavier loads

Users looking for a utility-focused alternative to standard eBikes

What Makes the GT33 Different from a Regular eBike?

Unlike standard eBikes designed mainly for commuting, the GT33 is built with cargo capacity and utility in mind. Its reinforced frame, high-torque motor, and extended seat allow it to carry more weight and handle real-world tasks, making it a practical solution for both transportation and everyday use.

FAQ

Is this a cargo electric bike?
Yes, the GT33 is designed as a cargo eBike with a reinforced frame and the ability to carry additional weight and gear.

Can this bike carry heavy loads?
Yes, the GT33 is built for cargo use with a strong frame and high torque motor to support heavier loads.

Is this suitable for commuting?
Yes, the GT33 is well suited for commuting, errands, and everyday transportation.

Can this bike be used for longer trips?
Yes, the large battery and dual-battery ready design allow for extended range riding.

Is this bike stable when carrying cargo?
Yes, the GT33 features a balanced frame design and wide tires to maintain stability even when loaded.

What makes this different from a standard commuter eBike?
Compared to a standard eBike, the GT33 is designed for carrying capacity, higher torque, and real-world utility, making it more versatile for daily tasks.
